desc: 即热恒温活水清洗、暖风烘干、座圈加热与缓降盖
leaf: 智能马桶盖（电子坐便盖）
name: 即热恒温暖风烘干坐便盖款

shots.intent: 首屏低角度开盖一次交代整机轮廓、盖板比例与侧控面板，抓搜索点击
shots.textZone: 顶部 30% 干净留白；右下 15% 放一条短 CTA 带

shots.intent: 把日常困扰并列成六格建立共鸣，再引出本品机制
shots.textZone: 标题左上；六格文字居卡片下部，卡片上部留空

shots.intent: 两张并列卡片解释即热供水快与恒温稳的机制差异
shots.textZone: 说明行在顶部；卡片文字居中，卡片下方留白

shots.intent: 用带滑轨刻度的分组行说明温度与水流多档可调，降低选购顾虑
shots.textZone: 标题左上两行；右侧自上而下四组滑轨行，刻度标签在滑轨下方

shots.intent: 夜间暗场展示柔光照明，强化夜起使用的场景联想
shots.textZone: 标题左上，副线在标题下，右中部三点图标作装饰，下部留暗场

shots.intent: 用 90 度侧剖分屏交代座圈与铰链构造，说明体感来源
shots.textZone: 英文小标签在右场中上部；中文说明在画面下沿；标题左上

shots.intent: 四格图标图阵覆盖全家使用需求，兼作人群广度与安心感背书
shots.textZone: 标题在顶部；四格两列，图标在格内左下、标签在图标右侧

shots.intent: 三个信任块讲防水防溅、缓降静音与断电保护，消除用电安全顾虑
shots.textZone: 标题顶部；三块左右交错；每块标题行与说明行分层

shots.intent: 干净收口：整机正视加一条短 CTA，把前面卖点归拢成一次下单动作
shots.textZone: 上部 25% 留白给标题与卖点小字，底部 15% 放一条 CTA 带

style.backgroundSystem: glazed porcelain wet-area wall tile with a matching tile floor, consistent tile grid and perspective, shallow recessed depth, one frosted glass panel as the only soft element
style.iconSystem: thin #5B7C99 line icons inside matching outline circles, uniform 1.5px stroke, minimal geometry
style.lightingSystem: cool 6200K high-reflection studio lighting, broad soft key from front-left with a top scrim, controlled specular reflections on chrome and glazed porcelain, soft unified contact shadow, no hard double shadows
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: cool porcelain-and-chrome bathroom fixture commerce; fixed palette #F1F4F6 body, #C6CFD8 chrome, #5B7C99 accent, #33414D text; cool 6200K high-reflection studio lighting; background of glazed porcelain wall tile with matching tile floor; modern geometric sans-serif; thin #5B7C99 outline circular line icons; clean premium product photography mixed with minimal infographic modules; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting or color temperature
no brand name, store name, logo, watermark, member badge or QR code
no price, discount, coupon or shipping-time copy
no numeric specs for water volume, spray or pressure level, heating temperature, dryer power, material grade, waterproof rating, dimension or trap distance
no warranty claim and no certification, test report or standard number
no electrical part touching water, no opened live enclosure
no child climbing or sitting on the fixture unsupervised
no filth or staining, nozzle and seat ring always clean
style.presentationRules: stable product scale and lens height per shot type, product centered on a vertical axis, lid open degree and hinge geometry identical between shots, tile grid never tilted
style.surfaceSystem: porcelain #F1F4F6 body with chrome #C6CFD8 hinge and control arm over a glazed ceramic bowl and #C6CFD8 tile floor, wall sheen identical in every shot
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, headlines #33414D, labels #5B7C99, short bold headlines, no decorative or handwritten faces
